item.title: Oro dads debate Cogon Market health scare
item.description: DESPITE confirmation from health officials that rumors of a leptospirosis outbreak at Cogon Public Market are unfounded, City Councilor Yevonna Yacine Emano says sanitation efforts must intensify, not relax. item.title: 92 surrender in Talaingod as amnesty deadline looms
item.description: WITH the deadline for national amnesty applications just weeks away, the push for peace in Mindanao is pushing forward, marked by a mass surrender of 92 former rebels in Davao del Norte and a surge of amnesty filings in Bukidnon. item.title: Carbs and Books

item.title: Masterson overpass halt raises safety concerns
item.description: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Construction of the P25-million pedestrian overpass on Masterson Avenue has been temporarily halted following a City Council resolution citing traffic congestion and alleged design flaws. item.title: PPI backs creation of media-citizen council in Oro
item.description: Grievances between media practitioners and their sources are expected to be resolved more efficiently as the Philippine Press Institute (PPI) supports the creation of the 13th media-citizen council in Cagayan de Oro City. The post PPI backs creation of media-citizen council in Oro appeared first on Gold Star Daily News.

item.title: Explainer: What the media-citizen council means for news consumers
item.description: On Thursday, January 22, the Philippine Press Institute (PPI) convened key stakeholders to form a media-citizen council—an initiative designed to promote responsible journalism and give the public a formal platform to raise concerns about news coverage.
